title: The Heavenly Secrets Eye Manifests
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was processing this earth-shattering truth, the projection of the Heavenly Secrets Eye slowly raised its hand, and a contract radiating eerie light materialized before him—a God-Slaying Blood Pact written with Heavenly Fate as ink and lifespan as paper.

text.content: The reverberations of funeral bells still echoed above the imperial capital, as ministers knelt trembling before the altar of the new emperor's enthronement ceremony. Yet Chen Ji's gaze was firmly locked onto the emblem radiating a dim glow—the very insignia of the Hall of Heavenly Secrets, its pattern identical to the fragment of the Tianji Record in his hand. Cold sweat slid down his spine, and an unprecedented chill seized his heart.

dialogue.content: (Waves of terror surging within) This is impossible... The Hall of Heavenly Secrets was destroyed a thousand years ago—why would it appear at the imperial ceremony? Could... could everything have been part of some higher being's design?

text.content: At that moment, the emblem of the Hall of Heavenly Secrets atop the altar suddenly blazed to life, as an illusory pillar of light shot skyward. Within the light pillar, a colossal eye spanning the heavens slowly opened—without distinction between sclera and pupil, it contained only a profound and boundless void, yet seemed capable of piercing through all falsehoods in the world. Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his mind, and the fragment of the Tianji Record involuntarily surfaced, trembling violently.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji... heir of the Tianji Record, castaway of fate." The voice did not come from his ears but exploded directly in Chen Ji's mind—ancient, authoritative, yet carrying an imperceptible weariness. "You think yourself a chess player? Laughable."

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the churning of his qi and said coldly: "Heavenly Secrets Eye? That existence that claims to control the world's fate? Why leave the highest heavens to come to this mortal realm?" His tone carried its usual mockery, and even facing this legendary manifestation of heavenly will, he remained unchanged in his sharp tongue.

dialogue.content: "Hmph." The illusory giant eye narrowed slightly, and a hint of bitterness crept into its voice. "You think I wanted to come? A thousand years ago, I was like you, believing I was favored by heaven and could defy fate." After a pause, the voice turned cold and harsh. "Until I discovered I was merely a watchdog fed by the Hall of Heavenly Secrets."

text.content: At these words, Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. He suddenly recalled the vague records in the Tianji Record fragment—how all previous prophets met untimely ends, and how the Hall of Heavenly Secrets was the mastermind behind collecting these prophecies. Could even this existence commanding the heavenly will be nothing more than a piece in the Hall of Heavenly Secrets' grand design?

dialogue.content: "The death prophecy you saw in Chapter 700." The Heavenly Secrets Eye's voice turned ice-cold. "That was not my masterpiece but a failsafe mechanism planted by the Hall of Heavenly Secrets—when a prophet's threat level exceeds the threshold, a fatal ending is triggered. Unfortunately, you have already been marked as a 'sacrificial piece'."

text.content: Chen Ji felt his chest tighten, as the phrase "sacrificial piece" pierced his heart like a blade. He had exhausted every stratagem, advancing step by step, believing he had carved a path through the three great sects' power struggles, only to discover that from the very beginning, he was merely a minor piece in some grander game. This profound sense of being utterly seen through rendered him nearly breathless.

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to the Heavenly Secrets Eye's revelation?

choices.text: Analyze calmly, and turn the tables
choices.description: Since you are also a piece, what is your purpose in telling me this? What did the Hall of Heavenly Secrets offer you that made you willing to be their watchdog?
choices.visible_reward: Gain more information about the Heavenly Secrets Eye
choices.risk_hint: May provoke the Heavenly Secrets Eye, leading to negotiation breakdown

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Secrets Eye's phantom hesitated momentarily, then let out a low chuckle: "Good, very good. For a thousand years, I finally encounter an ant who dares to question me." The laughter carried a hint of admiration. "Worthy indeed of being chosen by the Tianji Record."

choices.description: Since we are both pieces of the Hall of Heavenly Secrets, the enemy of my enemy is my friend. What do you need me to do?
choices.visible_cost: May be exploited by the other party
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence against the Hall of Heavenly Secrets
choices.risk_hint: Expose one's trump cards and weaknesses

dialogue.content: "Cooperation?" A hint of surprise tinged the Heavenly Secrets Eye's voice, and ripples actually formed within its void-like pupil. "Interesting. You are far wiser than those self-righteous hypocrites."

choices.text: Scoff and question, provoke to the end
choices.description: Oh? Even the Heavenly Eye has to serve as a dog's errand-runner? Then let me see what kind of entity this Tianji Pavilion is, to make a being who governs the Heavenly Dao bow and scrape.
choices.visible_reward: May provoke the other party to reveal more hidden trump cards
choices.risk_hint: If the other party turns hostile, the consequences would be unimaginable

dialogue.content: Above the altar, gusts of wind suddenly raged wildly. The phantom of the Heavenly Eye trembled violently. An invisible pressure like a mountain crashed down, and Chen Ji felt his five viscera and six organs quivering, nearly spitting out a mouthful of blood. "Brat, don't push your luck!" The voice exploded in his mind like thunder.

text.content: A moment later, that pressure slowly receded. The Heavenly Eye's voice rang out again, but with a hint of exhaustion: "Do you think I愿意如此? Tianji Pavilion has used the Heavenly Dao's laws as chains, imprisoning me above the heavens. For a thousand years, I watched one prophet after another be harvested by them, yet I was powerless."

dialogue.content: "And you, Chen Ji, are the variable I have waited a thousand years for." That giant eye slowly turned toward him, and a blurry image actually appeared in the Void—the scene of the Tianji Pavilion ruins, with countless seals' light flickering among the broken walls. "You are the only person who simultaneously possesses a Tianji Record Fragment and the will to resist. Killing you, Tianji Pavilion cannot bear to; keeping you, but that plants a variable on their chessboard."

text.content: Listening to these words, Chen Ji's mind raced. If what the Heavenly Eye said was true, then his greatest enemy at present was not any of the Three Great Sects, nor the Demon Path Saintess, but the Tianji Pavilion hidden within the mists of history. No wonder, no wonder no matter how he laid his plans, he always felt an invisible hand secretly manipulating everything.

dialogue.content: "I have a proposal." The Heavenly Eye's voice became solemn. "I can help you break the death trap implanted in Chapter 700—using my remaining Heavenly Dao authority to temporarily seal that insurance mechanism. The price is, you must become my eye planted inside Tianji Pavilion."

choice.prompt: Facing the deal proposed by the Heavenly Eye, how should Chen Ji choose?

choices.text: Accept the deal, become the vanguard
choices.description: Since I'm destined to be a chess piece anyway, might as well be one that can flip the entire board. Deal. Let's see how big this game really is.
choices.visible_cost: Become the Heavenly Eye's chess piece
choices.visible_reward: Death trap sealed, gain Heavenly Dao authority's protection
choices.risk_hint: May be used by the Heavenly Eye, lose autonomy

text.content: As the words fell, the phantom of the Heavenly Eye suddenly emitted blinding light. An esoteric rune shot out from that giant eye and merged into Chen Ji's Brow Center. In that instant, he felt the death curse in his body, like a fishbone stuck in his throat, truly quiet down—as if temporarily suppressed by some higher-level power.

choices.description: Becoming the vanguard is fine, but I need more chips. Beyond sealing the death trap, I also need to know Tianji Pavilion's weaknesses, and... the whereabouts of my sister Chen Nian.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more detailed intelligence on Tianji Pavilion and clues about Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: Expose the fact that Chen Nian is his weakness

dialogue.content: "Chen Nian?" The Heavenly Eye's voice suddenly paused, and a flicker actually crossed those Void pupils. "Heavenly Fate Lock Key... so that's it. Your sister being taken by the Holy Sect was no coincidence—she is precisely the ultimate tool Tianji Pavilion uses to disrupt prophecies."

choices.text: Flatly refuse, seek another way out
choices.description: Jump from one chess game into another? Sorry, but this Chen doesn't play chess pieces. You have your purposes, and I have my own path.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the freedom of independent action
choices.risk_hint: Lose the Heavenly Eye, this potential ally

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Eye fell silent. Within those void-like pupils, emotions churned complex and indecipherable—rage, disappointment, but above all, an unspeakable intricacy. 'You remind me of myself in my youth,' it finally said, only this single sentence. 'May your ending be different from mine.'

text.content: Just then, the space around the altar twisted abruptly. The Heavenly Eye's phantom began to dissipate, yet its voice grew ever clearer: 'Chen Ji, the true core of the Heavenly Secret Pavilion lies deep within the Kunlun Ruins, where the residual souls of generations of seers are sealed, along with... the complete version of the Tianji Record you've been seeking.'

dialogue.content: 'One final matter.' The Heavenly Eye's voice had faded to near inaudibility. 'That demonic path saintess beside you—her 'Demonic Path Mist' is not innate, but a product of Heavenly Secret Pavilion modification. Use her well... but also be wary of her. The Holy Sect has never been her true enemy—Heavenly Secret Pavilion is.' The words fell, and that massive eye dissolved entirely into the void, leaving only Chen Ji standing alone upon the altar, his heart churning with raging waves.

text.content: Night wind brushed across the altar, and that Heavenly Secret Pavilion emblem faded as well, as if it had never appeared. Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Record Fragment tightly, feeling within it a power more restless than before. A cold smile slowly curved his lips: Fine, each one telling better stories than the last. Since Heavenly Secret Pavilion wants to play, then let's play until the very end.

In the distance, the funeral bells of the imperial city still echoed, the clamor of the new emperor's ascension intertwining with the Heavenly Eye's earth-shattering revelations, forming a night of swirling treachery. And Chen Ji knew that from this moment, another name sufficient to change heaven and earth had been added to his list of enemies—Heavenly Secret Pavilion.
